title: Distribution Of Tax Revenues
definition: The constitutional and statutory mechanism through which tax revenues collected by the Union (Central) government are allocated between the Union and the States, and further sub-allocated among individual states based on recommendations of the Finance Commission under Article 280.
importanceInUpsc: Central to Indian Federalism, Fiscal Federalism, and Centre-State relations. Frequently tested in Prelims (Articles, Finance Commission mandates, tax types) and Mains GS Paper II (Cooperative and Competitive Federalism, vertical and horizontal imbalances).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Distribution Of Tax Revenues under Part XII of the Constitution.
Evaluate spatial distribution, vertical/horizontal devolution formulas, and institutional frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding Finance Commission criteria.
prerequisites: Constitutional Framework of India (Part XI and XII)
Basics of Taxation (Direct vs Indirect Taxes)
Role and Function of the Finance Commission
